description: Election Commission - Declare that - Mr. D. A. Don U. Chandana as a Member of the Seethawaka P/S Mr. Ambalam Kanakaiya as a Member of the Kayts P/S
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to resignations and deaths, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the nomination and declaration of new members to replace those who vacated their seats, which falls under election-related matters.
